stem: A Massachusetts pharmacist has completed the required administration training and maintains current CPR certification. Assume each request has a valid patient-specific prescription and is not the patient's first dose unless the option states otherwise. Which requests may proceed under the Massachusetts mental-illness/substance-use-disorder administration guidance? Select all that apply.

choices.text: A 34-year-old patient presents for a repeat prescribed dose of Vivitrol for substance use disorder
A 42-year-old patient presents for prescribed Lantus administration for diabetes solely because it is an injectable prescription drug
A 29-year-old patient presents for prescribed testosterone cypionate for gender-affirming care and asks to use the MH/SUD guidance as the legal basis
A 17-year-old patient presents for a repeat prescribed dose of Invega Sustenna for treatment of mental illness
A 38-year-old patient presents for a repeat prescribed dose of Abilify Maintena for treatment of mental illness

explanation.core_reasoning: The MH/SUD guidance requires more than recognizing an injectable drug. The pharmacist must identify a listed MH/SUD medication, the covered treatment purpose, and the guidance's patient conditions, including the age-18 minimum. A drug that may be administered under a different statutory pathway does not thereby become part of the MH/SUD pathway.

choice_analysis.A: Correct. Vivitrol is the listed SUD medication, and this adult repeat-dose scenario fits the stated conditions.
choice_analysis.B: Incorrect. Insulin glargine is not made eligible under the MH/SUD guidance merely because it is an injectable prescription drug.
choice_analysis.C: Incorrect for this question. Testosterone for gender-affirming care has a separate Massachusetts statutory administration category; it is not authorized by being placed on the MH/SUD medication list.
choice_analysis.D: Incorrect. Although Invega Sustenna is a listed mental-health medication, this guidance permits administration to persons 18 years or older.
choice_analysis.E: Correct. Abilify Maintena is a listed LAI antipsychotic, and this adult repeat-dose scenario fits the stated conditions.

related_facts: The guidance also excludes the patient's first dose and requires patient-specific prescribing, appropriate training, and current CPR certification.
explanation.mpje_trap: Memorizing product names without applying age, indication, and the correct statutory or guidance pathway.

reasoning_steps: Identify whether each drug belongs to the MH/SUD administration pathway rather than another administration category
Apply the treatment-purpose and age requirements to each request
Reject injectable-product status alone as a basis for administration authority
